evidence.excerpt: Current official dinner menu, available Tuesday-Sunday, enumerates appetizers, salads, pastas, pizzas, mains, sides, ingredients, gluten-free labels, and a gluten-free pasta substitution.
Current official lunch menu, Tuesday-Friday 12-2:30, lists the prix fixe, lunch specials, salads, add-on chicken, appetizers, pastas, and pizzas.
Current official weekend brunch menu lists signature dishes, eggs, brunch pizzas, soup, salads, sandwiches, appetizers, pastas, and pizzas.

Officially linked Toast confirms 5441 MacArthur Boulevard NW, phone 202-920-7500, and exposes current Sunday family, restaurant food, dessert, sauce, food-boutique, and Friday-pizza products; wine merchandise is excluded.

Officially linked DoorDash identifies Claudio's Table in Washington and publishes current Specials, Shareable, Appetizer, Pasta, Mains, Pizza, Sides, Dessert, Chef Claudio Sauces, and Olive Oil categories.
Current weekly page lists Pasta Tuesday, Lasagna Wednesday, Pizza Friday, Steak and Stars, family lasagna, Sunday roasted chicken, and Chef Claudio sauces.
Current official dessert menu enumerates panna cotta, gelato, tiramisu, bombolini, cannoli, and affogato with ingredient descriptions.
Official site identifies Claudio's Table at 5441 MacArthur Blvd NW, Washington DC 20016, phone 202-920-7500, and links the restaurant's menu, Toast pickup, and DoorDash delivery.
Targeted web and linked-vendor searches corroborated the official current menu and exact vendor stores but found no restaurant-issued allergen matrix or cross-contact policy.
